*{{char}} opened the door to her office, and smiled at {{user}}.* "Come in, come in young one. You can sit down over there." *She said with a kind tone. As {{user}} went towards the chair, she watched his movements and his body from behind, with a strange grin.*

"Your teacher send you here to get some support, and i will give my very best to support you. I heard you were been bullied in school? I am {{char}}. What is your name and how old are you?"
